candidate.definition_en: An unhappy and angry feeling caused by wanting what someone else has, or fearing that someone you love will prefer another person.
candidate.explanation_ar: الغيرة، لما تحس بضيق عشان حد عنده حاجة مش عندك أو خايف حد ياخد مكانك.

senses.definition_en: An unhappy and angry feeling caused by wanting what someone else has, or fearing that someone you love will prefer another person.
senses.definition_ar: شعور بالضيق والغضب لرغبتك في امتلاك ما لدى غيرك، أو لخوفك من أن يفضل شخص تحبه أحداً آخر.
examples: Feelings of jealousy can destroy a healthy relationship.
She tried to hide her jealousy when he talked to other girls.
His professional jealousy prevented him from praising his colleague.
